lead: L. K. Advani is an Indian politician, born on 8 November 1927 in Karachi.
As of 2026, he is 98 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Home Affairs and has been recognised with Padma Vibhushan in Public Affairs and Outstanding Parliamentarian Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of L. K. Advani: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: L. K. Advani — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: L. K. Advani was born on 8 November 1927 in Karachi, and holds Indian nationality.

His listed education includes St Patrick's High School, Karachi, University of Mumbai, Rishi Dayaram and Seth Hassaram National College and Seth Wassiamull Assomull Science College and Government Law College, Mumbai, India.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: L. K. Advani — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, lawyer and autobiographer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Minister of Home Affairs (1998–2004), Deputy Prime Minister of India (2002–2004), Minister of Information and Broadcasting (1977–1980), Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
